StateRangeBudget bounds reachable values only; the restriction adapter removes unused ambient labels while preserving all bank bits, decoders and actual executions.

Helper-selected bank/states/strategy/decoders, original raw-row side information, declared support cardinality at most two, actual stopping on F, and leafwise forest/row-degree assumptions all match the endpoint. Constant/repeated queries remain charged.

The arbitrary normalized finite law permits zero weights, and correctness is required on the entire sampled range. A finite correct family F is obtained by indexing it directly, retaining its zero-probability points.
English d,b>=1 and 1<=M<=d specialize the Lean theorem, which also handles b=0 and M>d. Substitution D=max(2,Delta) yields exactly K,nu,L,Q,C,N and the displayed expected-length inequality.

The proof outline charges appended child pins, uses actual full-cube reference fibers, groups exact occupied bucket sets, compares only actual correct inputs, and pays actual helper entropy once. It makes no conditional-independence assertion for the actual law.
Entropy is base two in manuscript model.tex; Lean natural entropy is divided by Real.log 2. The deficit P-H(X)+H(Z) and all displayed coefficients agree.

The qualitative family theorem permits b and sigma to vary with fixed Delta; the explicit theorem fixes sigma, uses the displayed floors, coefficient eight, and exactly the stated remainder. The eventual coefficient 8*log(delta)+1 follows from the proved remainder-times-log limit.
Neither an unrestricted native-time lower bound nor a standalone arbitrary-arity renewal017 result is claimed.
